endorsements.name: David Hamann
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1091
endorsements.description: The sanitisation step of the Safe SVG WordPress plugin before 1.9.10 can be bypassed by spoofing the content-type in the POST request to upload a file. Exploiting this vulnerability, an attacker will be able to perform the kinds of attacks that this plugin should prevent (mainly XSS, but depending on further use of uploaded SVG files potentially other XML attacks).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: David Hamann
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1092
endorsements.description: The myCred WordPress plugin before 2.4.3.1 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks in its mycred-tools-import-export AJAX action, allowing any authenticated user to call and and retrieve the list of email address present in the blog
